# Use of AI ("SI") tools

As the NASA Space Apps rules require, this section states where and how AI was used.

## Code (AI-generated)
Most of the source code (backend, frontend, simulator, analysis/forecast engine and admin panel) was
**generated by Claude (Anthropic)** from our team's specifications. The team:
- defined the product: the four parts, the sensor-ingest design, the baseline + trend prediction approach, the zero-cost stack, and the white-and-gold visual direction;
- reviewed, tested and debugged the system, set up the database and hosting, and deployed it;
- is responsible for every design decision and for presenting and explaining the work.

## In the product
The **AURA Assistant** calls the Google Gemini API at runtime. Its answers are AI-generated and are
labelled in the interface as decision support, not medical diagnosis.

## Text
AI tools helped draft the README, these documents and parts of the submission text.

## Images, video and audio
Any AI-generated image, video or voice-over in our demo carries a visible "AI-generated" watermark or
label. No NASA logos, flags or mission identifiers were generated or modified.
